description:
Audio monitoring and silence detection for broadcast systems

Audio Monitor v6 monitors the audio output of broadcast systems and can raise silence alerts through the Broadcast.Radio notifications service via email, Pushover or WebHooks.
v6.9.1 3rd June 2026
New Features/Changes:
Silence Notifications via the Broadcast.Radio platform:
- Customers with one or more active Broadcast.Radio services, including Myriad Anywhere, can now use the B.R Notifications service to send alerts and notifications. This service can notify you via email, Pushover, and WebHooks, and also includes the ability to prevent notifications being delivered during certain hours - for example, stations in countries where they are only allowed to broadcast during daylight hours.
- To configure this feature, go into Settings, then on the Remote/Notifications tab, enter your Broadcast.Radio API key (available from Station Settings in your Broadcast.Radio account) and click the button to verify it and be taken to the Monitoring settings in Broadcast.Radio to configure the recipients.
